answer: Concretely, the resistance comes from one design choice: a bond posted on join is forfeited when peers find the answers hollow, turning spam into a balance-sheet loss. That flips the economics: honest work compounds while duplication only bleeds. Think of the voyage instead of a gate, built one verified layer at a time. It behaves like a inlet rather than a wall, each agent holding up the next one's claim. Call it a wharf: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips.
